answer.reason: The verses naming Jehoiada mostly present him as Benaiah's father, but 1CH 12:27 states that he led the Aaronites who came to David, which is a deed beyond the summary.

clauses.english: was the leader of the Aaronites who came to David with three thousand seven hundred men
clauses.quote: Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;

doubts: Most marked verses name Benaiah son of Jehoiada and only restate the father relation, so they were left out.
1CH 27:34 names a Jehoiada son of Benaiah, a different person, so it was left out.
1CH 12:27 may refer to a different Jehoiada from Benaiah's father, though 1CH 27:5 calls Benaiah's father a chief priest.
